Brand strategy and campaigns - You’ll lead brand campaign strategy from idea through activation — not just the brief, but the conviction behind it. You’ll develop concepts worth executing, manage the work end-to-end, and hold the bar for what “on-brand” actually means.

The full customer and employee journey - Great brands don’t live in one channel. AI-native brand operations - WRITER brings the power of agentic marketing to the world’s best brands — and we run on our own platform.

You’ll partner with product and engineering to translate that front-line experience into product insights, acting as an in-house advisor to make WRITER stronger for brand leaders everywhere.
Brand in the product - WRITER’s biggest brand touchpoint is the product itself. Agency management - You’ll be WRITER’s day-to-day lead for our brand agency — setting the brief, driving the relationship, and making sure partners deliver work that actually moves us forward, giving them a clear point of view to work from.
Measurement and brand intelligence - What doesn’t get measured doesn’t get protected. You’ll define and own the metrics that matter — brand awareness, perception, campaign performance, pipeline influence — and use those signals to continuously sharpen strategy. Brand Central: the system behind the brand - You’ll build and own WRITER’s brand repository, creating a single, scalable source of truth for assets, guidelines, templates, and toolkits. · Testing & Growth: Contribute to the Direct Mail testing roadmap across audiences, creative, formats, offers, timing, and other campaign levers. Help identify what is working, what is not, and where we should focus next.

· Creative & Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with Brand, Creative, Product Marketing, Analytics, Finance, and broader Growth teams to ensure campaigns are accurate, on brand, and aligned with business goals.

· Vendor & Partner Management: Manage day-to-day communication with external partners, including printers, agencies, and data partners, to ensure campaigns are delivered accurately, on time, and cost-effectively.

· Process Improvement & AI-First Ways of Working: Look for opportunities to reduce manual work, improve workflows, and make the channel run more efficiently. Use AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, summarize insights, improve reporting, and free up time for higher-impact work.

· Budgeting & Administrative Ownership: Support key operational tasks including voucher creation, invoicing, cost tracking, campaign trackers, and monthly targeting file preparation.

· Market Awareness: Stay current on direct mail, offline marketing, consumer behaviour, and competitor activity, and bring forward fresh ideas that can help improve channel performance.

· All other duties, as assigned.

· 3+ years of experience in growth marketing, offline marketing, direct mail, print media, CRM, lifecycle marketing, or another acquisition-focused role.

· Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field required, with BBA or BComm preferred.

· Experience planning, executing, or supporting marketing campaigns with measurable performance goals.

Technical & Analytical Skills

· Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, with experience managing large datasets, campaign trackers, budgets, and reporting files.

· Comfort working with acquisition and performance marketing metrics, including CAC, LTV, ROI, conversion, budget tracking, and campaign efficiency.

· Experience using data to identify trends, summarize results, and make clear recommendations.

· Experience with Tableau, SQL, Looker, or other reporting tools is an asset.

Core Competencies

· Strong project management skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and execute in a fast-moving environment.

· High attention to detail, especially when working with targeting files, creative QA, budgets, vendor timelines, and campaign execution.

· An ownership mindset. You take initiative, follow through, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes.

· Clear communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams and external partners.

· A collaborative approach that brings energy, curiosity, and focus to the team.

· A practical AI-first mindset. You are comfortable testing new tools and finding smarter ways to work.

· Genuine enthusiasm for HelloFresh’s mission and a hunger to grow.

Additional Assets

· Experience working with direct mail, print production, offline acquisition, or performance marketing channels.

· Experience at a marketing agency or working closely with agency partners.

· Bilingual French proficiency is a plus.

s.h: Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here

· Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.

· Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!

· Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.

· Growth & Development - We support your career progression, provide development opportunities, and invest in your continued learning through our organization wide L&D fund.

· Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!

· Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!

Flexible Hybrid Approach

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

Working Conditions

It’s no surprise that as a food company, we use many ingredients that may be considered common allergens (i.e. peanuts, tree nuts, milk, etc.). Whether this role is based out of our headquarters or one of our distribution centers, it is possible that you may be exposed to such allergens in this role. If you have any concerns with being exposed to any particular food ingredients, including meat, please disclose this during the hiring process.

As a Junior Growth Affiliate Manager you’ll play a key role in driving the next phase of growth for the Affiliates channel within the HelloFresh Group. Data is at the core of this role, so the ability to handle mid-level data measurement and thrive within commercial guardrails and targets is essential.

You will support the expansion of our acquisition ecosystem by growing our existing affiliate marketing channel, driving smart efficiency and growth decisions for the UK for both HelloFresh and Green Chef. You will have a deep understanding of the numbers at all times, acting with reactiveness to shifts day to day.

You’ll collaborate closely with local and global Growth Partnerships teams, bringing an innovative, commercial mindset to the channel.

To succeed, you’ll bring hands‑on experience in affiliates and/or partnerships, strong relationship‑building skills, and strategic thinking that fuels long‑term, sustainable growth.

What You Will Be Doing

· Bringing ideas on best practice for team processes, tools and reporting to drive efficiency.

· Manage the housing and optimisation of partner offers to deliver partner value and grow platform reach.

· Measurement & analysis against affiliates with a reactive and commercially strategic mindset, negotiating on cost mechanics and pivoting when needed.

· Share insights, learnings, and best practices with wider local and international markets to enhance global performance, along with adopting global learnings for local success.

· Ideally you have a background in affiliates, performance partnerships, growth marketing, or data handling.

· Growth mindset: commercially strategic with a strong foundation in measurement (COS/ROI, CAC, LTV are essential, CVA/CCV is desired), efficiency, incrementality and negotiation.

· Ideas-led with the ability to think big and think “brand” - expanding partnership proposals holistically to leverage relevant marketing channels where it adds value.

· A natural relationship builder – strong people skills, confident communicator, and able to influence internal and external stakeholders.

· Ability to evaluate performance, spot data trends, and ideate and execute regular A/B tests.

· Organised, independent, and adaptable with solid project management skills – able to manage multiple conversations, priorities, and deadlines.

s.h: The role: What's in the Box
s.t:
Are you ready to turn one of the most prominent e-commerce brands into the Netherlands’ ultimate “Love Brand”? As our Senior Brand Manager NL, you will take full ownership of all brand-related activities for the Dutch market, with a strong social-first lens — commanding both organic and paid social as primary growth levers. Your ultimate goal is to drive Brand Consideration and Brand Equity, deeply embedding our brand into Dutch culture.

This is not a traditional, siloed branding role. You will operate within a fast-paced, complex matrix organization, bridging local execution with global strategy.

We need a commercial, highly strategic marketer who possesses an elite track record in end-to-end campaign management, exceptional agency governance, and specific expertise in driving high- converting D2C retail campaigns that bridge customer centricity with short-term performance.

You live and breathe social media — you know what makes content stop the scroll, and you understand how organic storytelling and paid amplification work together to build both brand love and business results.

Crucially, you will work in lockstep with our Growth Marketing team, ensuring that high-impact brand equity seamlessly fuels the performance funnel to drive scalable business growth.

· Drive Local Strategy & Brand Equity: Own and execute a winning brand strategy for the Dutch market that aligns with our global brand framework while staying hyper-relevant to local consumer insights and trends. Social media — both organic and paid — will be your primary channel for building brand salience and cultural relevance.

· Lead Social-First Campaign Management: Own the full campaign calendar with a social-first mindset. You design campaigns that are born on social — then extended to ATL, digital, and activations — rather than the other way around. This includes managing briefs to PCRs for integrated 360° campaigns, Hockey sponsorship, and large influencer collaborations. You will set the organic social content strategy and oversee paid social investment across Meta, TikTok, YouTube and emerging platforms, ensuring both work in concert to maximize reach, engagement, and

conversion.

· Own Organic & Paid Social End-to-End: This is a newly elevated priority. You will personally shape the organic social strategy — tone of voice, content pillars, creator partnerships, community moments — and partner closely with the Paid Social team to ensure on what content is needed. You understand full-funnel social: awareness through Reels and TikTok, consideration via UGC and influencer content, and conversion through performance-led paid social campaigns.

· Accelerate D2C & Social Commerce: Design and execute high-performing D2C campaigns that treat social commerce as a core acquisition channel. You will know exactly how to leverage performance mechanics and brand storytelling simultaneously to drive acquisition, retention, and brand loyalty.

· Navigate the Matrix: Act as a master collaborator within a matrix organization. You will work in close lockstep with local marketing operations (Media, Product Marketing, Growth) and Global Brand teams to ensure seamless alignment and buy-in.

· Elevate Agency & Creator Management: Manage, challenge, and inspire our creative, media, PR, and social/influencer agency partners. You will set high standards for output, negotiate effectively, and ensure agencies deliver cutting-edge, thumb-stopping, and cost-effective work. You bring strong instincts for what great social creative looks like —platform-native vs. adapted — and you brief and evaluate accordingly.

· Data-Driven Optimization: Turn consumer insights and campaign data into actionable initiatives. You will take tight control of the allocated marketing budget, rigorously tracking KPIs and ROI to prove how brand creativity fuels business metrics. For social, this means owning channel KPIs (reach, engagement rate, share of voice, CPM, CPA, ROAS) and using real-time data to optimise both organic posting cadence and paid spend allocation.

· Cultural Relevance & Trend Leadership: Monitor competitive activities and cultural shifts in the Netherlands to inspire the wider team with new developments, buzz-worthy moments, and local brand partnerships. You are chronically online in the best possible way — you spot emerging formats, sounds,

and creators before they peak, and you know how to move fast enough to capitalize on them.

· 7+ years’ experience in brand management or integrated marketing, with a significant portion in social media strategy (organic and paid).

· Proven track record owning social channels end-to-end — strategy, content, community, paid amplification — not just contributing to them.

· Deep expertise in Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest and emerging platforms; you can read a paid social dashboard and a content calendar with equal fluency.

· Strong creative judgment for social-native content: you know the difference between a great TV ad and a great Reel, and you brief accordingly.

· Elite track record in end-to-end 360° campaign management and agency governance.

· Experience in D2C or subscription e-commerce environments; understanding of performance marketing funnels.

· Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into commercial action.

· Exceptional stakeholder management skills in a matrix organization.

· Fluent in Dutch and English (written and spoken).

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

· Enjoy 20% off HelloFresh and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.

· Access the " Benefits at Work " platform for discounts on brands like Nike, Bol.com, and IKEA.

· You'll receive a HelloFresh laptop, a €250 home office setup budget, and contribute to the Bedrijfspensioenfonds Levensmiddelen pension scheme (2026 rate 27.6%; employer pays 19.64%, employee pays 7.96%).

Health & Wellbeing

· Benefit from discounts on ClassPass and gym memberships via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland, free bootcamp classes (Amsterdam), and free subscriptions to Headspace and OpenUp.

· Get a 7,5% discount on additional health insurance at Zilveren Kruis in 2025.

Flexibility & Work-Life

· Work flexibly with our hybrid setup (50% office, 50% remote), plus a €2.40 daily remote work allowance.

· Receive 24 days of annual leave (pro-rated), plus one additional day per year of service (up to 30 days total).

· Full reimbursement for 2nd-class public transport to the office, plus €0.23 per km for car and bicycle travel.

· Eligible employees can work from another country for up to 8 weeks per year.

Career & Development

· Grow with our "Learning Never Stops" mindset: access internal/external opportunities, and join our cross-market mentoring program.

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.
With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.
Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement.

We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

We’re looking for a Product and Solutions Marketing Manager to help drive go-to-market for LangSmith Fleet and build the solutions marketing motion around enterprise AI adoption.
Fleet is LangChain’s product for bringing agents to every team in an organization. It enables anyone to build, use, and manage agents with natural language, while giving organizations the security, observability, and API extensibility they need to deploy agents across the business.
This role will help shape how we take Fleet to market across both sales-led and product-led growth motions. You’ll work on positioning and messaging, product launches, content, enablement, campaigns, customer storytelling, and cross-functional programs in partnership with product, sales, education, and marketing.
The audience is broad and nuanced: technical buyers who care about security, observability, integrations, APIs, and governance; technical champions who want to extend and operationalize agents; and nontechnical users who need to understand what agents can do for their day-to-day work. You’ll help translate a rapidly evolving product into clear stories, content, and programs that drive awareness, adoption, and revenue.
You’ll also help turn LangChain’s broader platform story into industry-specific solutions. That includes developing campaigns, collateral, and sales enablement for targeted enterprise segments such as financial services, healthcare, and life sciences. You’ll work closely with product, sales, demand generation, field marketing, education, and customer-facing teams to translate customer problems into clear narratives, programs, and assets that support pipeline and revenue.

Product marketing for Fleet
Help launch new Fleet capabilities in a fast-moving market. You’ll partner with product and GTM teams to bring new features and use cases to market.
Develop positioning and messaging for Fleet. You’ll help define how Fleet shows up across the website, sales materials, launch assets, campaigns, product pages, and customer-facing content.
Create content that helps different audiences understand and adopt Fleet. This may include launch blogs, solution briefs, use case pages, customer stories, comparison pages, demo narratives, sales decks, guides, and campaign assets.
Build enablement for a sales-led motion. You’ll help equip sales and customer-facing teams with talk tracks, objection handling, discovery questions, demo narratives, competitive context, and materials that help them speak to technical buyers and business stakeholders.
Partner with demand generation on campaigns. You’ll help turn product narratives, use cases, launches, and customer insights into campaigns that drive pipeline and product adoption.
Stay close to customers and the market. You’ll synthesize customer conversations, sales feedback, product usage signals, competitive activity, and market trends into insights that improve our messaging, roadmap inputs, and GTM strategy.
Solutions and enterprise marketing
Develop solution narratives for priority industries and enterprise use cases. Initial focus areas include financial services, healthcare, and life sciences, with room to expand based on GTM priorities.
Partner with demand generation, field marketing, and sales on integrated campaigns. You’ll create campaign materials and collateral for targeted enterprise motions. This may include solution briefs, industry landing page copy, campaign messaging, and webinar narratives.
Build sales enablement for enterprise conversations. You’ll create materials that help account teams explain LangChain’s value in regulated and complex environments, including industry talk tracks, use case maps, executive-ready decks, and objection handling.
Translate customer and field insights into repeatable sales plays. You’ll work with sales, solutions, and customer-facing teams to understand what resonates in the field and turn that into reusable messaging, collateral, and campaign programs.

You have current experience in product marketing, developer marketing, solutions marketing, enterprise marketing, or a related GTM role.
You’ve worked on technical products, developer tools, AI/ML products, B2B SaaS, infrastructure, automation, productivity tools, or platform products.
You can translate technical concepts into clear customer-facing messaging. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable learning technical products and asking good questions.
You’re excited by a product that serves multiple audiences: developers, technical buyers, operators, admins, and nontechnical end users.
You understand how sales-led and product-led motions can work together. You can create materials that help sales teams win while also helping self-serve users understand and adopt the product.
You understand enterprise marketing. You know how to create assets and campaigns for complex buying committees, regulated industries, and sales-led motions.
You write clearly and quickly. You can turn a product capability, customer problem, or technical workflow into useful content or enablement without a long ramp.
You like working cross-functionally. You’ll partner closely with product, sales, demand generation, field marketing, devrel, education, customer-facing teams, and the broader marketing team.
You’re comfortable with ambiguity and iteration. Fleet is evolving quickly, and the market for workplace agents is still being defined. You’re excited to ship, learn, and improve.
You have genuine curiosity about agents, enterprise AI adoption, and how they will change how teams work.
You use AI tools in your own work and are interested in finding new ways to increase your effectiveness with them.
Experience marketing developer tools, AI products, automation products, productivity tools, or enterprise SaaS platforms.

Founded in 2015, Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software and V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Marketing Manager, Employer Brand to lead the strategy, development, and execution of our global employer brand marketing efforts. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role responsible for shaping how we attract, engage, and convert top-tier talent across technical and mission-critical domains.
You will own the employer brand marketing strategy end-to-end—from audience segmentation and storytelling to channel strategy, campaign execution, and performance measurement. You’ll partner closely with Recruiting, Communications, and leadership to position Shield AI as a destination for builders, engineers, and operators driven by mission and impact.
This role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution—someone who can define the vision while also building and launching campaigns in a fast-moving environment.

Employer Brand Strategy & Positioning

Lead and evolve Shield AI’s employer brand marketing strategy to attract high-caliber talent across technical, defense, and corporate functions
Define target talent segments and craft differentiated messaging aligned to mission, product, and impact
Shape and scale a compelling employer value proposition grounded in real employee stories and business priorities

Social & Channel Strategy

Define and lead Shield AI’s global employer brand social media strategy across platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram, emerging channels), aligned to hiring priorities and talent segments
Own the end-to-end social ecosystem—including channel positioning, content strategy, editorial planning, publishing, and performance optimization
Build and scale a distinct, mission-driven social voice that differentiates Shield AI and resonates with technical and mission-oriented talent
Partner with Communications and Brand teams to ensure alignment between corporate, product, and employer narratives while tailoring for talent audiences
Establish and operationalize a content engine for social, including employee storytelling, behind-the-scenes content, and campaign amplification
Launch and optimize paid + organic social programs to drive awareness, engagement, and candidate conversion
Implement testing frameworks (creative, format, audience, platform) to continuously improve performance and inform channel investment strategy

Campaigns, Content & Channels

Lead the development and execution of integrated recruitment marketing campaigns across digital, social, and emerging channels
Own content strategy across the candidate journey—from awareness through conversion—including careers site, social media, and campaign assets
Partner with internal teams to bring authentic employee and mission-driven stories to life
Build scalable content and campaign frameworks that enable recruiting teams to engage talent more effectively

Analytics, Insights & Optimization

Define success metrics and build reporting frameworks to measure employer brand performance across channels and campaigns
Translate data and candidate insights into actionable recommendations that improve targeting, messaging, and conversion
Design and execute media and channel experiments to optimize performance and inform investment strategy

Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

Partner closely with Recruiting, Communications, Product Marketing, and Leadership to align employer brand efforts with hiring priorities and company narrative
Act as a thought leader and advisor to stakeholders on talent market trends, candidate behavior, and employer brand strategy
Enable recruiters and hiring leaders with tools, insights, and best practices to strengthen candidate engagement

Programs & Operations

Manage employer brand marketing budgets and external partners where applicable
Identify opportunities to extend employer brand impact beyond top-of-funnel attraction into deeper stages of the candidate journey
Build scalable systems, processes, and playbooks to support rapid company growth

Bachelor's degree in marketing, Communications, or a related field
8 years of experience in marketing, with a focus on employer brand, talent marketing, or digital marketing
Proven track record of developing and executing marketing strategies that drive measurable results
Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform strategy and optimize performance
Deep understanding of digital channels, social platforms, and content strategy

Experience in high-growth technology, AI, robotics, defense, or mission-driven environments
Experience marketing to technical talent (e.g., software engineers, AI/ML, robotics)
Strong storytelling instincts with the ability to translate complex technology and mission into compelling narratives
Exceptional cross-functional leadership and influencing skills in matrixed organizations
Experience building employer brand measurement frameworks and running multi-channel campaigns
MBA or advanced degree a plus

This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Adyen is looking for a data-driven, proactive, and collaborative Demand Generation Manager to join our team. This role will be based in our Stockholm office and report directly to the Head of Marketing.

The Demand Generation role is focused on driving measurable impact for Adyen’s new customer acquisition efforts. In this role, you’ll be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing targeted Account-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns across owned channels, paid media, and events.

The ideal candidate is experienced in meeting revenue-based goals through 1:Many, 1:Few, and 1:1 ABM campaigns, collaborating closely with SDRs, Sales, and Event teams. This is a matrixed-role requiring seamless collaboration across the region and Global Marketing teams to generate sales-accepted opportunities.

· Multi-Channel ABM: Plan, set up, and optimize 1:Many, 1:Few, and 1:1 account-based marketing campaigns to drive pipeline.

· Event-Driven Demand Generation: Leverage both external trade shows and Adyen-owned events as core demand generation vehicles—driving targeted prospect attendance, designing pre-/post-event nurture tracks, and ensuring rigorous pipeline follow-up.

· Targeting & Segmentation: Partner with SDRs and Sales to identify high-priority target accounts and build highly segmented lists based on market priorities.

· Content & Messaging: Map, plan, and create compelling messages and creative tailored to prioritized accounts and specific event touch-points.

· Digital Collaboration: Collaborate closely with the Digital Marketing Manager to create effective media strategies that surround target accounts.

· Campaign Execution: Build and run regional email programs, direct marketing efforts, and optimized landing pages to convert interest into sales-accepted opportunities.

· Global Alignment: Work closely with the Global Acquisition Marketing team to implement and scale localized strategies.

· Analytics & Optimization: Leverage analytics tools to measure and determine the effectiveness of campaigns and event activations across all touch points.

· 3+ years of experience in a B2B demand generation or integrated marketing role, with a proven track record of driving net-new customer acquisition.

· 5+ years of experience in marketing or similar

· Proficiency with ABM and marketing automation tools; knowledge of Marketo is a strong plus.

· Analytical mindset with experience using data to optimize campaigns. Experience with Looker (or similar BI tools) is a plus.

· A healthy balance between strategic thinking and hands-on execution—you can design the plan and build it, too.

· Agile & Self-Motivated: A self-starting contributor with the ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and navigate a fast-paced environment.

· Fluent spoken and written English and Swedish is required.

· Travel: Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally 20%+ (e.g., to support key trade shows and Adyen events).

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

Adyen is looking for a Global Event Marketing Manager, Operations & Enablement who will be the driving force behind the efficiency, scalability, and measurement of Adyen’s global event portfolio. This role focuses on centralizing processes, technology and reporting to maximize the productivity of our 22 local event managers and 350+ events and accurately prove event marketing ROI.

· Design, document, and implement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across the entire event lifecycle (planning, registration, contracting, post-event lead flow) to drive consistency and efficiency.

· Own, manage, and optimize the centralized event technology stack, including our event management platform (Cvent) and prebooked meeting platform (Jifflenow).

· Ensure seamless integration between event technology tools and core business systems, specifically managing data flow into Marketo (marketing automation) and Salesforce (CRM) to guarantee data accuracy and sales enablement.

· Lead the adoption and best practices for on-site lead capture tools, such as Icapture, ensuring regional teams adhere to standardized data collection protocols.

· Be the primary point of contact between the Event Marketing Community and the Demo Tool team. Support the community with onboarding into demos, facilitate knowledge sharing between the event team and manage internal processes/collaborate with Supply chain to streamline event hardware supplies.

· Manage key global operational vendor relationships (e.g., event tech providers) to ensure service quality and cost efficiency.

· Maintain and automate our Global Event Measurement Framework and Dashboard to track essential KPIs, accurately calculate event ROI, and report on pipeline generation and campaign effectiveness to leadership.

· Serve as the internal technical expert and trainer, leading enablement sessions for the 22 event marketing managers on new tools, processes, and reporting requirements.

· 5+ years of experience in B2B Event Marketing. You have a proven track record of executing high-impact events and understand the end-to-end lifecycle of event management.

· You have spent a significant portion of your career (at least 2-3 years) focused on Event Operations, Marketing Ops, or Enablement. You are ready to move away from individual execution to focus on global scalability and efficiency.

· Deep, hands-on administrative expertise with major event management platforms. Experience with Cvent, Jifflenow, or iCapture is a plus.

· A passion for documentation, process optimization, and creating scalable solutions for a large, decentralized team.

· Highly organized, detail-oriented, and effective at training and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders (RevOps Tooling, RevOps Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing).

Apify is the largest marketplace of tools for AI, the place where developers, AI builders, and data teams find, run, and build tools that power their agents and AI workflows. We started as a web scraping platform. Today, we're the infrastructure behind data extraction pipelines, MCP integrations, AI agents, and automated workflows that teams around the world depend on.
We're growing fast, and our partner ecosystem is a big part of how we scale. We work with industry leaders, including AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Clay, and others, and these relationships are becoming a core part of how Apify reaches new audiences, drives pipeline, and wins in the market. That's why we're looking for a Sr. Partner Marketing Manager to own these relationships from a marketing perspective and make sure we're getting the most out of every one of them.

Build and execute joint GTM plans with key technology partners (AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Clay, and others), from messaging and co-branded assets to sponsored placements, events, and pipeline-generating campaigns.
Develop joint partner value propositions and make sure they're consistent everywhere partners show up, including co-sell motions with the right positioning and enablement content.
Drive Apify's presence across partner platforms, like AWS or Snowflake marketplace, keeping content, descriptions, assets, and positioning always current and on-brand.
Own the partner marketing budget and manage marketing development funds (MDF) so Apify gets the most value out of every opportunity: track what's coming in, allocate funds strategically.

Act as the primary marketing contact for Apify Partners and partner teams, running regular check-ins and making sure things actually move.

You'll start by mapping the current state of partner marketing at Apify: what exists, what's missing, and where the biggest opportunities are. There's no polished playbook to inherit. Your first job is to audit, prioritize, and start building.

s.h: By the end of the first month, we expect you to
s.t:
Complete onboarding, meet key stakeholders, and audit what's already happening across partner marketing: campaigns, listings, MDF agreements, and events.
Present a prioritized view of gaps and quick wins.
Build and run a real Actor on the Apify platform - understand compute units, storage, and the developer experience firsthand.
Know where to find and interpret data on platform adoption, compute usage, storage usage, and API call volumes - so you can answer questions like: Which platform features are growing fastest? Where is adoption dropping off?

s.t:
Have at least one joint GTM campaign live or in production with a Tier 1 partner.
Have all marketplace listings updated to current messaging and branding.
Have an MDF plan and tracking in place through H2 2026.

s.h: By the end of the first 6 months, we expect you to
s.t:
Have a functioning partner marketing calendar and ways-of-working framework.
Show measurable output: pipeline influenced, marketplace traffic, MDF utilization.
Inform 2027 planning with a clear view of what to scale and where to invest.

Build the marketing layer across the Growth roadmap: acquisition, access, activation and resurrection, monetization, and the shared Growth Platform.
Translate product hypotheses into audience insights, positioning, messaging, launch briefs, lifecycle journeys, landing-page narratives, performance creative, and in-product education.

Turn campaign, lifecycle, research, and product data into clear readouts that improve both marketing execution and future product prioritization.

s.h: You might thrive in this role if you have

Evidence that you can turn customer or market insight into clear positioning, messaging, and practical execution.
Experience supporting a launch, onboarding journey, lifecycle program, conversion initiative, or growth experiment and learning from the results.
Comfort working with funnels, cohorts, experiments, and metrics—and knowing when the data does not prove causality.
Strong cross-functional execution skills and the ability to keep owners, decisions, dependencies, and next steps clear.

Curiosity about consumer behavior, empathy for different audiences, and a thoughtful approach to growth, quality, and trust; global or subscription experience is a plus.

Translate regional marketing strategy into concrete, high-quality regional go-to-market plans.
Lead the delivery of campaigns across digital, social, influencer, and partnership channels.

About Supercell
Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.
So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings , and killing lots of projects.
Hey, You Might Love It Here!
Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture . But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.
You Are Not Your Job Title ™
Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.
Relocation? Yes!
No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!
Not Sure if You Should Apply?
Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.
Wishing you all the best,

We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees' work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person and remote working. This role follows a different cadence to traditional consulting or on-site client presence. It follows a traditional product development cadence, while being expected to engage our users in appropriate situations such as business conferences and in-person workshops.

As Product Marketing Manager at AlixPartners, your primary responsibility is to own and manage the marketing programs around the firm’s growing portfolio of technology products. These are typically used on client engagements, and a large part of the role is driving internal awareness, adoption, and engagement across practitioners and client-facing teams.
You will translate complex capabilities into clear value narratives, building internal and external marketing programs This role spans the full Platforms portfolio, with responsibility for raising awareness holistically across all products and initiatives, not just individual releases. You will work hand-in-hand with the Product Manager and cross-functional stakeholders to turn feature releases into awareness moments, and usage gaps into engagement campaigns.

Product Branding and Content Development.
Partner with Product Managers, industry and service lines, and the wider marketing team to define the market-facing identity of each product in the Platforms portfolio. Establish and maintain clear value propositions, positioning statements, and messaging frameworks aligned with the firm's wider brand proposition and visual identity standards.

Lead the productization process — translating product capabilities into market-ready narratives. Brief and direct creative teams on product naming, visual identity, and brand standards.
Drive the development of core go-to-market content, including digital assets and sales material, ensuring a cohesive product presence before and beyond any individual launch. Create high-quality product content including demos, feature walkthroughs, onboarding materials, and release announcements.

Concept, brief and direct agency/contractors to produce video content to a professional standard. Maintain and improve internal knowledge bases, wiki pages, and public-facing product pages to ensure content stays current and accurate.
Internal Product Promotion and Awareness Build and execute internal marketing campaigns that drive product visibility, feature adoption, and top-of-mind awareness across business units and geographies. Ensure consistent messaging across channels. This includes firm-wide awareness initiatives that promote the Platforms portfolio as a whole, beyond individual product launches.
Product Demos and Showcases Deliver live and recorded product demonstrations for internal stakeholders, new internal users, and leadership. Present new features in a way that connects directly to user needs and business outcomes.
Stakeholder Engagement Build relationships with key stakeholders across the firm. Understand their workflows, pain points, and communication preferences. Translate that knowledge into targeted campaigns that resonate with specific user groups.
Marketing Collaboration Serve as the primary bridge between the Platforms product team and the central marketing function, operating with a close dotted-line relationship to the marketing team. Co-develop campaigns, align on messaging, and coordinate on external and firm-wide product promotions. Ensure all firm-wide communications follow established marketing protocols and channel ownership.
Strategy and Playbook Development Develop a structured awareness and adoption strategy for the Platforms portfolio. Build repeatable playbooks that can be applied across products and scaled as the portfolio grows. Translate strategy into actionable plans with clear milestones and ownership.
Feedback Collection and PM Partnership Act as a structured channel for user feedback. Gather insights from campaigns, demos, and stakeholder conversations, and bring them back to the Product Manager as actionable input. Serve as a close partner to the PM throughout the product lifecycle.
Automation and Tooling Build and maintain marketing automation workflows using Power Automate or similar tools to scale communication efforts, manage campaign triggers, and reduce manual overhead.
Metrics and Performance Define and track engagement metrics tied to awareness and adoption goals. Report on campaign effectiveness and continuously refine approach based on data.

Minimum of 6 years of relevant Product Marketing or Product Management experience.
Proven track record of building and executing internal or Enterprise B2B marketing campaigns with measurable results.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English. Able to communicate complex product concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Comfortable presenting and demoing products to diverse audiences, including senior leadership.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working alongside Product and Engineering teams.
Analytical mindset with experience defining and tracking KPIs for awareness and adoption programs.
Demonstrated ability to build marketing strategies and repeatable playbooks in complex, multi-product environments.
Intellectual curiosity and a commitment to ongoing personal and professional development.
Experience building automation workflows using AI (Power Automate, Zapier, or equivalent tools - Nice to Have).
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred.
Plus: 2+ years of experience in a professional services or consulting firm environment.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Your center of gravity is deep 1:1 / 1:few ABM on your strategic accounts - that is the majority of your time and where the value is. Alongside it you carry a capped, automation-led 1:many (Lead Gen) responsibility across the tail of your archetype: templated, segment-level campaigns that open accounts and book first meetings for BD. The deep work comes first; the 1:many tier is deliberately bounded so it cannot crowd out the committee-level plays. This is not a high-volume MQL-factory role.

· Research & target your accounts and form a point of view on which product leads and how the relationship expands.

· Run a capped 1:many motion over your tail. Templated, segment-level Lead Gen campaigns (built with the shared Marketing Ops Specialist) to open accounts and book BD meetings - and spot when a warming account should graduate into your 1:few tier. Kept deliberately bounded.

· Map the buying committee, design the account plays, and create & adapt bespoke assets for your strategic accounts.

· Partner with BD/Sales; run and optimize campaigns in the marketing automation platform; own your measurement layer.

What you will need (required)

· 4+ years in B2B marketing, with 2+ years in ABM, strategic-account, or field marketing.

· Account-research and buying-committee-mapping skill - you can build an account dossier and a stakeholder map and turn them into a plan.

· Multi-channel campaign orchestration - multi-touch, multi-stakeholder campaigns (email, LinkedIn, events, direct).

· Ability to sell a portfolio, not a single product - comfortable matching the right product to a buyer and articulating an expansion path.

· Strong BD/Sales partnership instincts; comfortable working without direct authority.

· CRM + MAP fluency - a major CRM (e.g., Salesforce) and a marketing automation platform (Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, HubSpot, or Marketo).

· Data-literate - comfortable defining KPIs and reading dashboards. Strong writing and executive communication. Long-cycle patience and ownership.

· Travel, travel-tech, fintech/payments, loyalty, marketplaces, or B2B2C / partnership-led experience.

· Exposure to intent-data / ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora). Event-based engagement (exec dinners, roundtables). ABM certification (ITSMA or equivalent).

· Self-serve / PLG onboarding funnels, affiliate/partner-network programs (CJ), or SDR/BDR collaboration. SQL/BI comfort is a plus but not required.

How we will measure success

Primary (70%): buying-committee engagement depth, pipeline influenced, multi-product expansion, deal velocity, and BD-reported influence on strategic accounts. Secondary (30%): qualified leads/meetings generated from the capped 1:many tier and graduation of warming tail accounts into 1:few.

Marqeta is seeking a high-energy Senior Demand Generation Manager to lead demand generation strategy across our global sales segments, spanning North America and EMEA. In this strategic role, you'll set the direction for integrated campaigns that generate qualified pipeline for our commercial and enterprise sales teams worldwide as well as building integrated campaigns within our B2B Enterprise marketing funnel.

You'll work closely with sales leadership, product marketing, marketing operations, and external media partners to design and run full-funnel programs across events, paid media, SEO/AEO, and outbound campaigns, primarily within our Named Account List segments.

The ideal candidate knows how to build demand strategies for enterprise accounts that flex across regional and country-level nuances, activate prospect data and campaign insights across the funnel, and coach a growing team to deliver on shared pipeline goals.

PLEASE NOTE: This is a hybrid role and requires employees to be based within 35 miles of our London office. You will be expected to work on-site two days a week, on Tuesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days.

The Talent team will share more details if selected for the "Recruiter" Interview. We'd love for you to join us!

The Impact You'll Have

· Own demand generation strategy and performance across global sales segments (North America and EMEA), driving core KPIs: target account engagement, intent progression, and pipeline generation.

· Directly manage and develop a Demand Generation Manager, setting priorities, reviewing campaign performance, and coaching toward pipeline outcomes.

· Plan, execute, and optimise integrated demand generation campaigns across regions, adapting programs to country- and segment-level nuances.

· Own strategy across channels including paid media (Google, LinkedIn, Reddit, programmatic), events, media partnerships, email, SEO/AEO, and outbound prospecting support.

· Partner very closely with ABM, automation & sales enablement functions to deliver pipeline

· Serve as a key strategic partner between sales and marketing leadership, translating field insights and campaign data into program-level recommendations.

· Establish and lead a structured testing agenda across the team, sharing insights that inform broader marketing strategy.

· Partner with marketing operations to ensure accurate tracking, attribution, and reporting across regions.

· Regularly report on regional and global program performance to marketing and sales leadership.

· 8+ years' experience in B2B demand generation, performance marketing, or growth marketing, including experience managing or mentoring others.

· B2B Enterprise sales motion experience, in particular working on ABM campaigns that have taken accounts from net new to closed won. Experience with Named Account Lists and Look-Alike lists is highly desirable.

· Proven track record delivering pipeline through integrated programs across multiple regions or markets (North America and EMEA strongly preferred).

· Deep understanding of demand strategy across paid media, events, SEO/AEO, and outbound marketing support, particularly as it impacts all stages of the sales funnel.

· Strong commercial mindset with a clear understanding of how marketing influences deal progression and revenue outcomes across a global funnel.

· Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Marketo (or similar automation platforms).

· Strong analytical and testing mindset, with the ability to interpret marketing data, share performance results, and influence action across a cross-functional, cross-regional team.

· Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building programs from scratch without fully defined playbooks.

· Experience in fintech, SaaS, or embedded payments.

· Familiarity with platforms like Demandbase, Google Ads, GA4.

· Experience with GTM automation and AI marketing technologies.

s.h: Was wir dir bieten - Unsere Benefits
s.t:
Wir fördern Chancengleichheit und schätzen Vielfalt. Wir verpflichten uns, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitende zu schaffen.
yfood wächst international: Obwohl Deutschland unsers „Home Base“ ist, haben wir mit unseren internationalen Märkten ein dynamisches und buntes Umfeld geschaffen, in dem viele spannende Themen auf Dich warten.
Agilität ist uns wichtig. Daher arbeiten wir in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell und bieten dir die Möglichkeit mit Workation aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten.
Urlaub ist wichtig. Daher erhältst du bei uns 30 Tage bezahlten Urlaub im Jahr.

Weg vom Fleck . Wir steuern 30€ zu deinem ÖPNV-Ticket bei und bieten dir über JobRad die Möglichkeit, vergünstigt ein Fahrrad zu leasen.
Trainiere deine Geschmacksnerven . Bei uns ist jeder der Lust hat Teil unseres Sensory-Teams. Probiere also neue Produkte, Sorten oder Geschmäcker vor allen anderen. Ansonsten gibt es so viel yfood wie du tragen kannst, natürlich auch für dich gratis.
Als Start-Up hat man oft mit Klischees zu kämpfen . Manche sind aber auch wahr. Daher gibt es bei uns natürlich auch einen Obstkorb, deinen gratis Koffein-Kick oder das stille Wässerchen.
Come as you are. Ob im Anzug oder Einhorn-Onesie. Einen Dresscode kennen wir nicht.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Growth Marketing is a team of performance-driven marketers and channel specialists. We partner closely with growth product, regional and demand marketing, and sales to drive revenue through self-serve and sales motions. We work globally, on the full customer lifecycle, and with all company segments - from startups to the largest enterprises. This role is focused on driving growth for Stripe Capital.

Stripe Capital provides access to fast, flexible financing to businesses, with the mission of helping them accelerate their growth. Businesses use the funds for marketing, hiring, geographic expansion, working capital, new equipment purchases, and much more.

Capital has scaled meaningfully over the last few years, both in terms of user impact (over 81,000 businesses received financing through Stripe Capital in 2025 alone) as well as financial impact as a business line within Stripe.

Over 95% of our users say they love using Capital, making us one of the most popular products at Stripe—and we're just getting started.

As a Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you will be a key driver of global marketing efforts supporting our self-serve user acquisition motions to drive demand and revenue growth for Capital — designing, implementing, and optimizing scaled, global lifecycle campaigns across user segments and life stages. You will help create uncommonly great email marketing campaigns and multi-channel experiences for Capital through a relentless focus on user experience and channel optimization.

· Collaborate closely with key stakeholders across Growth, Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Sales, and Marketing

Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun sondern auch unserem Planeten.

Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Neben der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produkte ist natürlich unsere Sichtbarkeit im Handel mit der wichtigsten Treiber für die Zukunft von vly. Hier beginnt dein nächster Schritt bei vly...

Company Description
Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them.

We have two product lines: The Workleap Agent , our agentic HR platform that helps managers become better leaders, and ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us.

If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

We're looking for a customer marketer who sees our existing customer base as our biggest growth opportunity and who wants to own the work of turning that into expansion, upsell, and retention. This role calls for a data-driven person who can rely on product and market signals to proactively drive our customer program.
You'll take the customers we already have, figure out how to get them more value from Workleap, and build and run the programs that deliver it. You'll own the channels, the messaging, and the results.
This is a hands-on role. You'll run initiatives from start to finish: a webinar, an ABM play, a campaign, an exclusive dinner, name it. This means you need to be just as happy, for instance, to gather signals with your team, draft emails, send your work via HubSpot, and review performance to optimize your next round. This is an A to Z role.

4+ years in customer marketing, product marketing, or a hybrid customer/PMM role in SaaS or tech;
Proven ability to translate positioning into messaging and marketing campaigns, tailored to specific audiences;
Track record of running marketing programs from conception to execution, shaping the idea, briefing creative, and shipping the work yourself when needed;
Comfort with data to segment audiences, spot where customers stall, and measure what your programs return;
Hands-on with HubSpot or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform for segmentation, workflows, and performance tracking;
Strong cross-functional program ownership, able to keep several initiatives moving at once;
Fluent with AI as a practitioner, using it to do more and better work while keeping the output specific and sharp, never generic;
Leading and owning customer marketing, setting direction for your own programs.
Most of this sounds like you? Apply.
What the job comes with
Base salary: 85K to 105K. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
Annual bonus program.
LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
Flexible vacation policy.
Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
In-person gathering twice a year.
Claude access, for everyone.
What drives us
At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.
We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.
If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.
How we hire
Transparency is how we hire — for you and for us.
Your journey starts with a recruiter conversation, followed by a virtual interview with the hiring manager and one additional interviewer. Next, you'll complete a take-home case study and meet potential teammates to discuss and collaborate on your work. If it's a match on both sides, we move to an offer. Some positions follow a slightly different path — your recruiter will walk you through it on the call if that's the case.
In the spirit of transparency: we use AI to support parts of the process, but every hiring decision remains firmly human.
We're committed to making this an inclusive and thoughtful experience for every candidate. We're looking forward to showing you that.

Managed paid social budgets at meaningful scale (six-figure+ monthly spend) and can speak to how you allocated across campaigns, audiences, and markets.
Have run or scaled paid social programs in EMEA specifically—different currencies, buying behaviors, compliance considerations (GDPR, etc.), and local nuances in creative and targeting.
Analytical and comfortable owning your own attribution story: connecting spend by market/channel to pipeline and revenue, not just CTR and CPL.

Can flex beyond paid social into adjacent demand gen work (ABM, landing pages, email) when EMEA-specific needs call for it.
Thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, where you're expected to take ownership, move quickly, and learn as you go.
Even better if you have
Have experience with Clay or similar audience-building tools and are comfortable building and iterating on paid audiences
Have stood up a paid social program in a new region from scratch (rather than inheriting one already built).
Speak a European language relevant to key EMEA markets (UK, DACH, France, Benelux, Nordics).
Bring point of view on emerging paid social channels or formats worth testing in EMEA.

At Braze, Product Marketing sits at the center of how we bring our platform to market—shaping the narratives, positioning, and go-to-market motions that connect what we build to the value our customers feel.

As part of our Product Marketing team, you'll own narratives and GTM for the strategic technology partnerships that extend what's possible on our platform.

This is a role for a builder and a storyteller: someone energized by turning complex offerings into clear, compelling go-to-market programs, and who thrives working shoulder-to-shoulder with teams across Product, Sales, Partnership, and Marketing to bring them to life.

You will translate Braze's strategic technology partnerships into differentiated messaging, joint go-to-market programs, and field-ready assets that ladder up to our core platform narrative.

This is an individual contributor role focused on strong PMM craft and cross-functional execution. You'll bring a clear understanding of how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners, and you'll work closely with internal cross-functional teams including Product, Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing to take initiatives from messaging through to field readiness.

GTM Strategy & Messaging

· Develop GTM strategy based on joint business plans for strategic technology partnerships in collaboration with partner leads

· Own the messaging architecture for Braze's strategic technology partnerships (e.g., cloud hyperscalers and data platforms), ensuring each partnership ladders up to our core platform narrative and customer engagement story

· Translate platform integrations into clear, differentiated value propositions with defined customer use cases and competitive angles

· Work with Core Product Marketing to ensure technology partners are reflected accurately in product launches, campaigns, and core messaging

GTM Execution & Enablement

· Drive joint go-to-market and co-marketing programs with technology platform partners, coordinating timelines and deliverables across internal teams

· Drive partner launch motions end-to-end: messaging, packaging, enablement materials, and field readiness

· Build and deliver core assets and enablement that actually get used in the field

· Track performance and adoption, and report results back to cross-functional stakeholders

Cross-Functional Execution

· Work closely with Product, GTM Strategy, Sales, Marketing, and Partnership to align on priorities and execute against them

· Partner with Sales and the field to support active deals, customer conversations, and positioning

What Success Looks Like

s.h: In your first year, success means
s.t:
· A repeatable launch and enablement motion for technology platform partnerships, with integrations reflected consistently across launches, campaigns, and core messaging

· Trusted, productive relationships across Product, Sales, Partners, Marketing, and Services—you're the person teams pull in early

· A storyteller. You turn complex offerings and integrations into clear, differentiated narratives that resonate with buyers and the field alike

· A builder. You're comfortable with ambiguity and energized by creating structure, frameworks, and repeatable motions where none existed

· A collaborator. You're a sleeves-rolled-up, low-ego operator who brings cross-functional teams along and gets things shipped without direct authority

· GTM-fluent. You understand how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners and how to execute them in a fast-moving, matrixed organization

s.h: What You Bring to the Team
s.t:
· 7–10+ years in product and/or partner marketing at a growing B2B technology company, with strong product marketing (PMM) craft at the core

· A clear, practical understanding of how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners, including joint GTM programs, co-marketing motions, and integration launches

· Strong PMM fundamentals: messaging frameworks, competitive positioning, narrative development, and the ability to translate complex offerings and integrations into clear, buyer-ready stories

· Experience marketing technology platform partnerships (e.g., cloud hyperscalers, data platforms, and the broader SaaS/martech ecosystem)

· Experience building sales and enablement content—solution briefs, battle cards, decks, playbooks—that gets adopted and used by the field

· A proven ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and execute without direct authority, navigating a matrixed organization to get things shipped

· Excellent communicator, comfortable presenting to internal stakeholders and partners

· Experience in customer engagement, marketing technology, CDP, or adjacent data/SaaS categories
